description: Feedback rule. colors[i] is G/O/R for slot i. code = sum(digit_i * 3^i) with G=0, O=1, R=2 (slot 0 least significant).

cases.note: item wanted by nobody -> all red
every item wanted elsewhere -> all orange
duplicates: orange counts no copies; any other non-green slot wanting it suffices
item 3 wanted by nobody -> every copy red, however many are placed
second copy of a green item is RED: the only slot wanting it is green this turn
one green; other copies red because the only slot wanting item 1 is green
slot 1 orange (slot 2 wants 2); copies of 0: slot 5 green; others orange because slot 1 wants 0
